description_en: Queries the resources of a service instance based on parameters such as the service instance ID, Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN), and region ID
description_zh: 通过服务实例 ID、资源 ARN（Aliyun Resource Name）、地域 ID等参数，查询满足条件服务实例资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-resources --service-instance-id si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceResources

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。每页最大行数100行，默认行数20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this to the NextToken value from a previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance
parameters.name: service_instance_id

fields.name: key

fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the service instance. Valid values:

AliyunResource: an Alibaba Cloud resource.

ContainerResource: a container group (pod) resource
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例资源类型。可能的值：

AliyunResource：阿里云资源。

ContainerResource：容器组（Pod）资源

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions. Valid values:

ExpireTimeStart: The start of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
<notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

ExpireTimeEnd: The end of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
<notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

PayType: The billing method.><notice> This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>
  Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

ResourceARN: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

resource name (ARN)
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。有效值：

ExpireTimeStart：预付费资源到期时间的查询开始时间
<notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>
ExpireTimeEnd：预付费资源到期时间的查询结束时间
<notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>

PayType：付费类型。><notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>
有效值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费。

 Resource Name）

MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。每页最大行数100行，默认行数20行

NextToken.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created

RenewStatus.description_en:
The renewal status. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: auto-renewal.

ManualRenewal: manual renewal.

NotRenewal: no renewal
RenewStatus.description_zh:
续费状态，取值：
AutoRenewal：自动续费。

The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:

Month: month.

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

running: The resource is running.

waiting: The resource is pending.

terminated: The resource is terminated.

This parameter is returned only for container resources
Status.description_zh:
运行状态。可能的值：

running：运行中。

waiting：待运行。

terminated：停止运行。
仅查询容器资源时，才会返回运行状态
